mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte wasting, while cobicistat is dependent on renal function for clearance and may accumulate with declining kidney function; both agents can cause hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (potassium and magnesium), and cobicistat levels closely; consider alternative antifungal therapy if possible; ensure aggressive electrolyte supplementation and hydration.
